en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a fortified stone wall with battlements and a tower, part of a hilltop city fortification. There is an exterior staircase on the wall leading up to the ramparts, and an arched gate in a larger tower structure further back. The foreground is rocky and barren. Printed captions in Greek and French at the top identify the scene, and a web address is printed at the bottom right.
